title: TagR, a newly identified member of the MarR family of transcriptional regulators, represses the NRPS operon in Klebsiella oxytoca.
authors: Perez, Cristopher; Lopez-Luis, Mario A; Jimenez-Sanchez, Carlos J; Hernandez-Pompa, Fermin I; Rodriguez-Valverde, Diana; Rivera-Gutierrez, Sandra; Rosales-Reyes, Roberto; Chimal-Cazares, Fernando; Soria-Bustos, Jorge; Yanez-Santos, Jorge A; Cedillo, Maria L; De la Cruz, Miguel A; Fox, James G; Ares, Miguel A
one_liner_zh: 该研究鉴定并表征了Klebsiella oxytoca中MarR家族转录调控因子TagR，通过结构预测、MD模拟和EMSA证实其直接结合并抑制NRPS操纵子，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法上MD模拟和结构预测可借鉴。
abstract: Toxigenic Klebsiella oxytoca strains produce the pyrrolobenzodiazepine enterotoxins tilimycin (TM) and tilivalline (TV), which contribute to the development of antibiotic-associated hemorrhagic colitis. The biosynthesis of these toxins depends on the nonribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) operon located within the til pathogenicity island. Although several global and signal-responsive regulators of NRPS operon expression have been identified, the regulatory network governing enterotoxin biosynthesis remains incompletely characterized. In this study, we identified a previously unrecognized transcriptional regulator encoded within the til pathogenicity island of K. oxytoca. This protein, designated TagR (Tilivalline-associated genes repressor), is a member of the MarR family and acts as a negative regulator of NRPS operon expression. Structural prediction, molecular dynamics simulations, and biochemical analyses demonstrated that TagR exhibits the characteristic architecture of MarR family regulators and forms a stable homodimer. Deletion of tagR led to significant upregulation of the NRPS-associated genes npsA, thdA, and npsB, while complementation restored transcriptional repression. Electrophoretic mobility shift assays confirmed that TagR binds directly and specifically to the regulatory region upstream of the NRPS operon, supporting a mechanism of direct transcriptional repression. Consistent with these findings, loss of TagR significantly increased the cytotoxicity of K. oxytoca culture supernatants toward HeLa cells. Collectively, these results identify TagR as a direct repressor of the NRPS operon and expand the regulatory framework governing enterotoxin biosynthesis in toxigenic K. oxytoca. This study provides new insight into the transcriptional control of virulence-associated genes and establishes TagR as a previously unrecognized component of the regulatory network controlling TM and TV production.IMPORTANCEElucidating the mechanisms by which toxigenic Klebsiella oxytoca regulates enterotoxin production is critical for understanding the pathogenesis of antibiotic-associated hemorrhagic colitis. TagR is identified as a previously unrecognized MarR family regulator that directly represses the nonribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) operon responsible for tilimycin (TM) and tilivalline (TV) biosynthesis. This discovery uncovers a novel regulatory mechanism governing toxin production and offers new perspectives on virulence regulation in this emerging intestinal pathogen.
abstract_zh:
产毒克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella oxytoca）菌株产生吡咯并苯二氮卓类肠毒素tilimycin（TM）和tilivalline（TV），这些毒素与抗生素相关性出血性结肠炎的发生发展密切相关。这些毒素的生物合成依赖于位于til致病性岛内的非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS）操纵子。尽管已鉴定出多个调控NRPS操纵子表达的全局性和信号响应性调节因子，但调控肠毒素生物合成的调控网络仍未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们鉴定了一个先前未被识别的、由K. oxytoca的til致病性岛编码的转录调控因子。该蛋白被命名为TagR（Tilivalline相关基因阻遏物），属于MarR家族成员，作为NRPS操纵子表达的负调控因子发挥作用。结构预测、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和生化分析表明，TagR展现出MarR家族调控因子的典型结构特征，并形成稳定的同源二聚体。tagR的缺失导致NRPS相关基因npsA、thdA和npsB显著上调，而互补实验则恢复了转录抑制。电泳迁移率变动分析证实，TagR直接且特异性地结合于NRPS操纵子上游的调控区域，支持其直接转录抑制的机制。与这些发现一致的是，TagR的缺失显著增加了K. oxytoca培养上清液对HeLa细胞的细胞毒性。综合来看，这些结果将TagR鉴定为NRPS操纵子的直接阻遏物，并扩展了产毒K. oxytoca中肠毒素生物合成的调控框架。本研究为毒力相关基因的转录调控提供了新见解，并将TagR确立为控制TM和TV产生的调控网络中一个先前未被识别的组成部分。

**重要性** 阐明产毒克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella oxytoca）调控肠毒素产生的机制，对于理解抗生素相关性出血性结肠炎的发病机制至关重要。TagR被鉴定为一个先前未被识别的MarR家族调控因子，直接抑制负责tilimycin（TM）和tilivalline（TV）生物合成的非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS）操纵子。这一发现揭示了调控毒素产生的新机制，并为这种新兴肠道病原体的毒力调控提供了新视角。
